label: Beginner · Lesson 33
title: Clothes and weather
intro: The weather and clothes: It’s cold. I’m wearing a coat. Today’s words and what we learnt before.
intro_uz: Ob-havo va kiyim: Havo sovuq. Men palto kiyganman. Bugungi so’zlar va oldingi mavzular.
message: Beginner · Lesson 33 · Clothes and weather. Do it before the next lesson. Rasmga oling yoki chop eting.

parts.title: Weather and clothes
items: Lola is wearing a {red scarf|scarf red}.

parts.title: Put the words in order
items: is / Lola / wearing / a / red / scarf

parts.title: What we learnt before
items: There {is|are} a sofa in my room.

parts.title: Write about today
parts.uz: Bugungi ob-havo va kiyimingiz haqida 4 ta gap yozing

items.prompt: Write 4 sentences: what the weather is like today and what you are wearing.
items.hint: Example: Today it’s cold. I’m wearing a black coat and a hat.
